nodes.label: fuser Changelog
nodes.rationale: 0.17.0 moved Filesystem trait methods to &self requiring Send + Sync + 'static, replaced Vec<MountOption> with a structured Config API, added multi-threaded event loops (Config::n_threads) and an experimental AsyncFilesystem, and made abi-7-xx feature flags runtime checks instead of compile-time gates.

nodes.label: fuser macos-no-mount Compile-Only Mode
nodes.rationale: Lets a Mac without the macFUSE SDK still type-check the full callback and binary API, which is exactly what quicKFS's check.sh relies on for Clippy coverage.
